description:
RARE TARZANA FALLS END UNIT – LIGHT, SPACE & PRIME INTERIOR LOCATION!  Tarzana Falls is the most gorgeous architecturally compelling  cmplex in Tarzana w/waterfalls & lush landscape! Welcome to one of the most desirable residences in Tarzana Falls! This move-in ready corner unit is ideally situated in the heart of the community, offering exceptional privacy, abundant natural light, and easy access to the resort-style amenities.
From the moment you enter, you'll appreciate the unique architectural design, high ceilings, spacious floor plan, and inviting living spaces. The bright and airy living room features a cozy fireplace and sliding doors that open to an extensive & expansive wrap-around patio—perfect for outdoor dining, entertaining, gardening, or simply relaxing in your own private retreat. The remodeled kitchen is beautifully appointed with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, and plenty of workspace for the home chef. Adjacent dining and family living areas create a comfortable flow for both everyday living and entertaining.  Upstairs, the impressive primary suite feels like a private sanctuary, complete with its own fireplace, sitting area, large walk-in closet, private balcony access, and a luxurious en-suite bath featuring dual vanities and a relaxing spa tub. The oversized ensuite secondary bedroom also enjoys its own private bathroom, making it ideal for guests, family members, or roommates.  Additional highlights include hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, plantation shutters, a convenient guest powder room, in-unit laundry, and a versatile huge bonus room perfect for a home office, gym, hobby room, or additional storage space.  The private direct-access two-car garage provides convenience and security! 
Tarzana Falls is a beautifully maintained community surrounded by lush landscaping and mature trees, offering residents a sparkling pool, spa, tennis court, recreation room, and peaceful park-like grounds.  Located just moments from Ventura Boulevard's premier shopping, dining, entertainment, and transportation options, this exceptional home combines comfort, character, and convenience in one of Tarzana's most sought-after communities.
Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a special end-unit home in the heart of Tarzana!
